english: Yah! Hah! Teyah!
Not yet! You're not projecting your voice.\nLouder, stronger!
Yes!
They say the human body exerts its greatest strength\nwhen exhaling while vocalizing.\nIt's very important.
Also, always be conscious of your breathing!\nIf you run out of breath, you can't do anything.
Well, I hardly need\nto tell that to Hibiki the singer.
Singer!? Tsubasa-san, maybe,\nbut I'm not anything that grand...
I like Hibiki's singing voice!
Ahaha, I'm flattered...
Appearing out of nowhere, what are you saying.\n...Oh, everyone's here too.
You look well.\nHard to believe you're recovering.
My body's totally fine!\nI ate lots of rice!\nNow I just need to sharpen my dulled moves and my spirit!
She was critical until recently—\nunbelievable recovery.
Indeed. That Aria there\nkept asking Shirayuki about your condition\nduring the last operation.
Wh-what! How do you know that...!
Didn't you know?\nI transferred into Butei High's Information Department (Inquesta)\nas a second-year.
Four phone calls with Shirayuki.\nAll of them were checking on Hibiki's condition.
I think I told her she's stable, she's recovering,\nabout four times...
Huh? Aria-san's unexpectedly a worrier?\nShe never showed it\nat all!
Even though she was fighting with a face like a demon tile.
Ah, I get it, I get it!\nAt times like that you just keep asking!
In [NOEL]-san's case,\nisn't it just forgetfulness?
Gnununu... I told Shirayuki to keep quiet,\nbut I never thought Jeanne would hear about it...!
Ahaha. If you blush too much,\nRena'll take you home again.
Hauu!!
...Sadly, it seems too late.\nShe's already in "cute mode".
Hey, stop! Don't hug me!\nDon't pat my head! Don't take me away!
Such good friends. Nipah~!
If even Aria's helpless,\n"cute mode" Rena must be\ninsanely strong...?
If you approach to help,\nyou'll be intercepted by an invisible punch—\ncommonly known as the Rena-pan.
Nothing to do but leave her till it settles,\nhuh...
Sheesh. So lively\nI can't help stopping.
Oh, right! One more round!\nPlease!
Haven't you mostly gotten your feel back?
No. Just going back isn't enough!\nI have to go further and further ahead!
There's something I want to protect.\nI can't protect it just by fighting and winning,\nso I need to be more...!
...Understood. Let's do it!
Yes!
Just winning isn't enough, huh.\nAgainst Hibiki, no enemy stands a chance.
Her goal lies elsewhere than a warrior's, is that it.\nNo wonder she grows strong.
No, it's not like that at all!
I'm a total amateur at fighting,\nI had no resolve to fight,\nand Tsubasa-san even scolded me.
And Chris-chan too...\nBecause I was weak, she went out of control and got hurt...
That's why I wanted to become strong.\nI had no choice but to become strong.
Holding someone's hand is my fight—\nI think I understand what you meant\nby those words back then.
Everyone's here.\nDinner's ready,\nso please gather!
Ah, coming! I'll be right there!\nLet's go, everyone!
Honestly, her appetite is triple a normal person's...
//Screen fades to black, then background: town.
Damn it! They said to lend them my strength\nto end conflict!
That Mii...! It was all lies,\nand once they were done with me, I got tossed aside!!
//Event CG: Chris sitting with her knees hugged in a mandarin-orange box in an alley, looking dejected.
This is\njust like the old days...
I was supposed to be fighting to end conflict,\nbut I got sweet-talked by others and used...
And now I'm all alone again...
What am I supposed to do...!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: Butei High classroom.
Uwah! Food after training\nreally hits different!
You eat everything I cook—\nit's a problem, really.
I'm still growing!
Satoko should eat lots like Hibiki\nand get strong~.
That is clearly overeating!
She's burning that much, is all.\nExercise makes you hungry.
Sorry to interrupt your meal, but it's an emergency.
Jeanne? What's wrong?
Information from Informa.\nSomeone's rampaging downtown...\nwhile singing.
Singing... could it be Chris-chan...?
No need to think—move out!\nEven if it is Yukine Chris,\nyou just stop her! Right!
Yeah!\nJeanne-san, tell me the location!
Preparations to move out are ready.\nPut down your chopsticks and bowls and let's go.
Ah!? How embarrassing... ehehe.
Honestly, transform already!\nWe'll leave you behind!
//Battle map: town.\n//Black Hibiki and Black Tsubasa are wreaking havoc.
Fufu!
//Screen flash & shake, explosion sound.
Now, come...!
//Screen flash & shake, explosion sound.\n//Ally placement. Hibiki and Houki forced deployment.
There! That's them!
Not Chris-chan... me?\nMe and... Tsubasa-san!?
That gear's color...\nlooks like a black Symphogear, like the Black IS!
Welcome! Now, what shall we do?
//Black Hibiki summons grunts.
Stop! Why are you doing this...!
We'll stop them, Hibiki!
//Battle begins.
Who are you? What's your goal?\nCan't we get along?
Hibiki! Talking won't be easy!\nLike those Black IS,\nyou can't read their intentions at all!
I know! Still!
She looks like me when I went out of control...!\nJust rampaging with all her strength...\nthat's exactly why we have to talk!
...Hmph!
She's coming at us! Hibiki!
(Aren't you me...?\nThen I should be able to reach you...!)
//Talk event after Hibiki and Black Hibiki fight.
These moves, this power... and the song!\nShe's really just like me...
...Heh.
(But it's strange...\nher fists, I feel nothing from her fists...!\nEven though she's so much like me!)
Hey! Tell me!\nWhere did you come from,\nand what are you trying to do?
Useless.
Huh?
That softness gives birth to nothing.
What do you mean...?
//Talk event after Hibiki and Black Tsubasa fight. Hibiki can't choose to attack.
That swordsmanship is definitely Tsubasa-san's!\nIf Chris-chan fought her,\nno wonder she mistook her...
Begone.
You are Tsubasa-san!\nThen don't use your sword\nfor something like this!
Something like this...?
The Sakimori's sword should be a sword that protects people!
Yes.\nThat's why my sword is aimed at your neck.
No! I don't understand at all!\nThat's wrong, Tsubasa-san!!
//Event when Hibiki and Black Hibiki clash again.
Let's stop! Let's talk!!
...Meaningless. If people could understand each other,\nI never would have met you.
What does that mean? Tell me!
People can't understand each other!
This is bad!
Hibiki!!
You're in the way!
//Tsubasa blocks Houki and Aria's movements with an attack.
Tch! So this is Ame-no-Habakiri's swordsmanship!
Hibiki!! Fight! Hibiki!!
Shatter!
You damn idiot!!
//In battle, Chris support-guards and takes the damage instead of Hibiki.
That freaking hurt, dammit!!
//Chris appears next to Hibiki.
Chris-chan!!
Hmph, one more idiot.
Sheesh, what are you doing!?\nStill so naive!!\nI can't stand watching!
Sorry, but I really want\nto talk it out...!
First I'm settling the score\nwith these guys!
You fakes who tricked and attacked me!\nPay up your debt with sky-high interest!!
The me and Tsubasa-san who attacked Chris-chan...\nas I thought...?
Just stay out of the way!! You're in the way!!
Ngh...
Hibiki! She's right!\nIf you can't fight, fall back!
Leave it to us! Got it!
...Okay.
//Hibiki leaves the front line.\n//Battle resumes.
Your fists don't just hurt,\nthey piss me off!\nCopying Hibiki and all!
Copy? Hmph, fool.
Don't call me an idioooot!!
//Black Tsubasa and Chris clash.
I can see your sword lines!\nIf it weren't for that sneak attack!
Don't get cocky just from seeing them, fool.
Don't act so composed!\nI'll make that sour face cry!!
//Black Hibiki defeated.
I think that's enough of a greeting.
Tch, they ran!
//Black Tsubasa defeated.
That's enough of showing our faces.
Keh, just say you're running because it's getting dangerous!
//Battle ends when Black Hibiki and Tsubasa are defeated.
That's taken care of.\nLet's pull back for now.
Right.\nYukine Chris! Won't you talk with us a bit?
O-okay... just a little!
//After battle.
Let me thank you, Yukine Chris.\nThank you for saving Hibiki.
Wh-why are you thanking me?\nI just settled my debt!
Exactly. Such unnecessary meddling...\nHibiki's an idiot,\nso a little pain would've been fine.
Wasn't it Aria-san\nwho tried to rush to help first?
The first one who tried to charge in to help...\nwas Aria-san, right?
Moving almost simultaneously with Houki-san\nmeans she moved with reaction speed\nequal to the Akatsubaki?
She can't match an IS in acceleration.\nWhich means Aria\nmoved first.
So fast!!
You say she'd be better off getting hurt,\nbut you really love Hibiki-chan, don't you?
Wh-what are you saying!!\nHibiki's an important part of my partner corps!\nThat's all it is!!
Yeah yeah, we'll let you\nkeep telling yourself that.
By the way, where's Hibiki?
She's over there.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: town.
What's wrong? You're gloomy.
Yeah, just... shocked.
What Black Hibiki said to you?
Black me was like me when I went out of control.\nSo I thought if I talked to her like the people who saved me\ntalked to me, it'd work out...
But it didn't.\nIt felt like I was completely rejected by myself,\nand it was so sad...
Pulling you back was the right call.\nYou can't fight feeling like that.
Laura-chan, you fought your black self too,\nso you know—\nshe's really exactly like me.
She probably thinks the same way too.\nThat thought scares me...
Like, maybe the world's so full of conflict\nthat it'll never stop,\nenough to make me give up.
...Huh, is that all.
Huh... "is that all"...\nI'm being serious here!!
Found you! Hey Hibiki! What's with that face?\nIs it that again?\n"Maybe I'm cursed!"?
A gloomy face really doesn't suit you.
...Sorry.
You're down because you couldn't get through\nto the black one, right?\nSo what. How silly.
Silly...!
When you said you wanted to get stronger,\ndid I teach you anything with words?\nI just beat you up.
What did you say back then?\nYou didn't say "I don't understand, explain it with words,"\ndid you?
Ah...
In martial arts they say:\nget used to it rather than learn it, steal it rather than be taught.
There are things\nno master can convey with words.
Words aren't all-powerful.\nWhen I was taken into the Valkyrie Trace System,\ndid you save me with words?
I saved you with my fists.
A-and another thing!\nI'm bad with words so I can't say it well,\nbut I'm... very grateful to you, Hibiki.
You probably don't get it even when I say I'm grateful,\nbut that's how it is!\nSee, words can't convey it, can they?
Yeah, I don't get it at all.
In other words, there are many things\nwords can't convey.
If it's still too painful,\ncome to me.\nI'll... hug you...!
Houki-chan...
Hibiki, your punches are special.\nI got hit by them—I guarantee it!
That's right, that's it!\nThere were feelings I've conveyed with my fists all along!
No need to fear clashing.\nShe's like you, so she's tough anyway.\nGo at her head-on!
Yes!\nEven if words fail, I'll try conveying it with my fists!
Haha! You're such an idiot!\nAlready looking refreshed!
Ehehe, yeah.
Hibiki aside—\nyou idiots hiding there! Come out!
What!? Someone's there!?
//The hidden members come out.
Ahaha, you noticed?
I should've used a listening device\ninstead of eavesdropping after all.
Hey, I'll arrest you!
Ooh, we got to hear a nice story?
I was moved...!
Shut up! I'm not a sideshow!!
Honestly, how tasteless!!
It can't be helped.\nEveryone was worried about Hibiki-san?
She's a precious friend!
If even Hibiki-san's depressed,\nanyone'd worry!
Aria-chan really does\nlove Hibiki-chan, right? Right?
Shut up shut up shut uup!!\nHole!!
//Event still: Aria, embarrassed and angry, about to fire her gun shouting "Hole!!".
H-hey! Don't actually shoot!
Shuuut up! You're all under arrest\nfor eavesdropping and defamation, caught red-handed!
Eavesdropping aside, we committed no defamation!
It's a false charge!\nI demand a lawyer present!
Silence! I'll blast a hole through the lawyer too!!
Calm down, someone stop her!
//Event still off.
Angry Aria-chan's cute too!\nTakeout!!
Kyaa! Hey, again!?\nStop...! Aaah!!
Amazing...\ncapturing a serious Aria...
Could be handy... haha.
That's the second time today.\nPoor poor Aria.
Now that I feel better, I'm hungry!\nI wonder what's for dinner!
Sheesh, I wasted my worry.\nWell, I'm off...
Wait, Chris-chan!\nLet's eat together!
Hah? What's this all of a sudden...
Let's call it a welcome party for the newbie, okay?
Who're you calling a newbie!?
What's your favorite dish?\nI'll put my all into making it.
Don't decide on your own!
Oops, not letting you escape.\nThe food gets fancier\nwith you around.
Siesta's cooking is delicious.\nIt'll easily exceed your imagination.
Everyone says so, see?\nLet's eat together, and fight together?
...Tch, fine.\nBut just the meal!
...But debts should be repaid,\nso I'll at least help out for my share of the meal.
You're not honest with yourself.
Coming from Aria, that...
I'll prepare three meals plus a 3 o'clock snack too!
Hmph!
//END
